skills.elemental_burst: Guiding the fragrances collected within the Case, Emilie converts them into pure Dendro energy, creating a Level Lumidouce Case and stowing existing Cases away. While it exists, the Level Lumidouce Case will not gather nearby Scents, but it will continuously cause Scented Dew to descend, attacking opponents within range and dealing Dendro DMG. During this time, drop of Scented Dew will descend every seconds, and opponent can become the target every seconds. When the duration ends, a Level Lumidouce Case will be recreated.
